text: 4.42 Re-export of goods imported under Advance Authorisation Scheme Goods imported against Advance Authorisation Scheme, which are found defective or unfit for use, may be re-exported, as per Department of Revenue guidelines. The authorisation holder has to inform the Regional Authority who has issued the authorisation before re-export of such defective goods.
